lean.statement:
noncomputable def unitSphereExp (w z : E) : E :=
  Real.cos ‖z‖ • w + Real.sinc ‖z‖ • z
approved_definition_context: E is a real inner-product space with its norm. Scalar multiplication is written with a centered dot in the mathematical reading.
Real.sinc x is sin(x)/x away from zero and has its continuous value one at zero.
HasDerivAt f v t means that the real-parameter curve f has derivative vector v at t; ContDiff real n is n-times continuous differentiability.
A tangent increment z at a unit sphere point w satisfies norm w equals one and real inner product w z equals zero.
